Cases: checks/parity/par-firststart.py:302-330 (J9.10 cases: ai-card-words, ai-controls-show-their-keys, ai-lights-the-list-only, ai-three-lines-with-their-actions, ai-in-progress-states-as-drawn, ai-rings-fill-as-each-need-is-met, ai-pasted-key-reaches-the-provider, ai-use-jev-asks-the-key-then-the-consent-then-chooses, ai-meaning-download-starts, ai-continue-is-always-on, ai-skip-leaves-the-marks-on); par-firststart prints the total line at :1129 and a MUTANTS table. The second mutant's red pattern is loose on purpose: which J9.10 case it turns red was not found by reading (the decision download is reached only through ai-setup.preview in these cases), so it may survive: that is itself the evidence for gap (2). Built in this lane (checks/parity/par-firststart.py, steps_ai_run): a loopback server (class Loop, 127.0.0.1 only) staged with `fixture provider-endpoint anthropic|laya <url>` (docs/CONTROL-SOCKET.md delta 60). New cases, each with its model mutant in the file's mutant list: ai-pasted-key-leaves-the-writing-line-connected (the loopback provider got one /validate POST with a bearer, the line reads ready with no actions), ai-jev-key-door-stores-the-key-and-asks-the-consent and ai-jev-allow-door-gives-the-consent-and-chooses-jev (each door alone), ai-decision-download-shows-progress-and-a-cancel (slow loopback model server: working, progress above 0, actions [cancel]), ai-cancel-stops-the-decision-download, ai-every-control-of-the-step-clicked-once (sweep of every `<line>.<action>` the lines offered against those clicked, expects none left). The old first mutant (AISetupDoors.fix .meaning) is kept; the old second mutant (AISetupDoors.fix laya) was never reached by the step (the step's Download calls AISetupStep.download), so it is replaced by the AISetupStep.download mutant. Unverified until a build runs it: that the real laya download leaves the line `working` with a progress figure when the rig's models folder does not already hold the model (settingsaimac-check.py _laya_fresh empties it; this check does not, and says NOT JUDGED/red if the model is ready).
